# Known round-trip deviations

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-roundtrip-report.js via `npm run test:roundtrip`. Do not edit by hand. -->

The golden corpus (`tests/unit/round-trip/`) asserts `unwrapTablesForHost(serialize(parse(wrapTablesForEditor(input)))) === input` byte-for-byte,
including trailing whitespace and final-newline state. Fixtures that cannot satisfy
that today are recorded here with their exact output and root cause — documented
honestly, never silently normalized away (#245). The test suite additionally asserts
that each deviation fails in exactly the way documented here, so an entry that drifts
(or quietly starts passing) breaks CI.

Output samples are verbatim. Independently of each listed cause, the serializer also
drops the final newline everywhere (#282).

## Final-newline-only deviations (#282) — 28 fixtures

These fixtures round-trip their construct byte-identically and differ only by the
missing trailing newline — one serializer defect shared by all of them:

## Construct deviations — 24 fixtures

### `blockquotes--lazy.md` (#283)

**Root cause**: lazy continuation lines are absorbed into the marked paragraph and the soft break joins them.

**Input**:

````markdown
> The quote starts marked
but continues lazily without a marker.
````

**Output**:

````markdown
> The quote starts marked but continues lazily without a marker.
````

### `blockquotes--simple.md` (#283)

**Root cause**: soft line breaks inside the quoted paragraph parse to a plain space; the two marked lines join into one.

**Input**:

````markdown
> A quoted line.
> A second quoted line.
````

**Output**:

````markdown
> A quoted line. A second quoted line.
````

### `code--span.md` (#284)

**Root cause**: code spans containing backticks are padded with spaces by the serializer.

**Input**:

````markdown
Inline `code`, a double-backtick span ``with ` inside``, and `*not emphasis*`.
````

**Output**:

````markdown
Inline `code`, a double-backtick span `` with ` inside ``, and `*not emphasis*`.
````

### `code-blocks--fenced-tilde.md` (#284)

**Root cause**: fence style is not recorded; the serializer emits backtick fences.

**Input**:

````markdown
~~~
tilde-fenced content
~~~
````

**Output**:

````markdown
```
tilde-fenced content
```
````

### `code-blocks--indented.md` (#284)

**Root cause**: indented code blocks are not distinguished from fenced ones; the serializer emits backtick fences.

**Input**:

````markdown
    indented code line one
    indented code line two
````

**Output**:

````markdown
```
indented code line one
indented code line two
```
````

### `emphasis--underscore.md` (#284)

**Root cause**: emphasis marker style is not recorded; the serializer emits * forms.

**Input**:

````markdown
This line uses _underscore emphasis_ and __underscore strong__ markers.
````

**Output**:

````markdown
This line uses *underscore emphasis* and **underscore strong** markers.
````

### `entities--named.md` (#285)

**Root cause**: HTML entities are decoded at parse and serialized as raw characters.

**Input**:

````markdown
Entities: &amp; and &lt; and &copy; in running text.
````

**Output**:

````markdown
Entities: & and < and © in running text.
````

### `escapes--punctuation.md` (#285)

**Root cause**: backslash escapes are decoded at parse and re-escaped per serializer policy (escaped # comes back unescaped).

**Input**:

````markdown
Escaped \*not emphasis\*, an escaped \# not a heading, and \[not a link\].
````

**Output**:

````markdown
Escaped \*not emphasis\*, an escaped # not a heading, and \[not a link\].
````

### `front-matter--yaml.md` (#289)

**Root cause**: no front-matter support; the opening --- parses as a thematic break and the closing --- turns the YAML body into a setext heading.

**Input**:

````markdown
---
title: Muninn
tags: [notes, markdown]
---

# Document body
````

**Output**:

````markdown
---

## title: Muninn tags: \[notes, markdown\]

# Document body
````

### `headings--atx-closing-hashes.md` (#284)

**Root cause**: ATX closing hash sequences are not recorded; the serializer emits the open form.

**Input**:

````markdown
## Closed heading ##

### Another closed one ###
````

**Output**:

````markdown
## Closed heading

### Another closed one
````

### `headings--setext.md` (#284)

**Root cause**: heading source form is not recorded; the serializer emits ATX headings.

**Input**:

````markdown
Top-level setext title
======================

Second-level setext title
-------------------------
````

**Output**:

````markdown
# Top-level setext title

## Second-level setext title
````

### `html--block.md` (#283)

**Root cause**: html:false parses raw HTML as paragraph text; tags survive but the block line structure collapses via soft-break joining.

**Input**:

````markdown
<div class="note">
  <span>raw HTML block</span>
</div>
````

**Output**:

````markdown
<div class="note"> <span>raw HTML block</span> </div>
````

### `links--reference.md` (#286)

**Root cause**: reference link definitions are resolved at parse and dropped; links serialize inline.

**Input**:

````markdown
A [reference-style link][example] in running text.

[example]: https://example.com/reference
````

**Output**:

````markdown
A [reference-style link](https://example.com/reference) in running text.
````

### `lists--bullet-dash.md` (#284)

**Root cause**: list marker style is not recorded; the serializer emits *.

**Input**:

````markdown
- first dash item
- second dash item
````

**Output**:

````markdown
* first dash item
* second dash item
````

### `lists--bullet-plus.md` (#284)

**Root cause**: list marker style is not recorded; the serializer emits *.

**Input**:

````markdown
+ first plus item
+ second plus item
````

**Output**:

````markdown
* first plus item
* second plus item
````

### `lists--ordered-paren.md` (#284)

**Root cause**: ordered-list delimiter style is not recorded; the serializer emits the dot form.

**Input**:

````markdown
1) paren-delimited first item
2) paren-delimited second item
````

**Output**:

````markdown
1. paren-delimited first item
2. paren-delimited second item
````

### `paragraphs--soft-wrapped.md` (#283)

**Root cause**: soft line breaks parse to a plain space, so author line-wrapping unfolds on serialize.

**Input**:

````markdown
This paragraph is hard-wrapped by the author
across three source lines so that no line
exceeds the column the author chose.
````

**Output**:

````markdown
This paragraph is hard-wrapped by the author across three source lines so that no line exceeds the column the author chose.
````

### `strikethrough--tildes.md` (#287)

**Root cause**: no strikethrough schema support; tilde characters are backslash-escaped by the serializer.

**Input**:

````markdown
GFM strikethrough markers like ~~struck text~~ pass through as plain text.
````

**Output**:

````markdown
GFM strikethrough markers like \~\~struck text\~\~ pass through as plain text.
````

### `task-lists--basic.md` (#287)

**Root cause**: no task-list schema support; the literal checkbox brackets are backslash-escaped by the serializer.

**Input**:

````markdown
* [ ] an open task
* [x] a completed task
````

**Output**:

````markdown
* \[ \] an open task
* \[x\] a completed task
````

### `thematic-breaks--variants.md` (#284)

**Root cause**: thematic break markup is not recorded; the serializer always emits ---.

**Input**:

````markdown
Before.

***

Between.

___

After.
````

**Output**:

````markdown
Before.

---

Between.

---

After.
````

### `whitespace--blank-lines.md` (#284)

**Root cause**: blank-line runs are not represented; block separation serializes as exactly one blank line.

**Input**:

````markdown
First paragraph.



Second paragraph after three blank lines.
````

**Output**:

````markdown
First paragraph.

Second paragraph after three blank lines.
````

### `line-endings--crlf (synthesized)` (#288)

**Root cause**: the editor pipeline is LF-internal (wrapTablesForEditor splits and rejoins with LF; markdown-it normalizes EOLs); CRLF input serializes as LF.

**Synthesized case**: paragraphs--plain.md with every LF replaced by CRLF.

**Input**:

(shown as a JS string literal because the sample contains CR bytes)

```
"The first paragraph stays on a single line and says nothing remarkable.\r\n\r\nThe second paragraph follows after one blank line.\r\n"
```

**Output**:

````markdown
The first paragraph stays on a single line and says nothing remarkable.

The second paragraph follows after one blank line.
````

### `whitespace--trailing-single-space (synthesized)` (#283)

**Root cause**: the parser strips the trailing space and the soft break joins the lines.

**Synthesized case**: inline literal with one trailing space (no hard break implied).

**Input**:

````markdown
A line with one trailing space 
continues here.
````

**Output**:

````markdown
A line with one trailing space continues here.
````

### `breaks--hard-two-spaces (synthesized)` (#284)

**Root cause**: hard-break marker style is not recorded; the serializer emits the backslash form.

**Synthesized case**: inline literal where two trailing spaces force a hard break.

**Input**:

````markdown
alpha  
beta
````

**Output**:

````markdown
alpha\
beta
````
